summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases to a temp directory (`dl("https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v"+V+"/"+arch+".zip",...)`), extracts and chmods the binary, then invokes it against the sibling `math_init.js` (`execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js],...)`). math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with hex-mangled identifiers and a rotated string-array decoder (`function WV8StW(...){...MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());return MmgoCP}`) followed by a 700+ KB const table of numeric/string tokens. The bundle is not referenced from the package's public API (`dist/cjs/index.js` exports only LambdaInvocationClient and generateApiGatewayEventV1/V2) and is reachable only via the preinstall Bun-exec path. The advertised purpose is an AWS Lambda invocation helper, which does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or a large obfuscated bundle. The preinstall hook fires automatically on `npm install`, running the obfuscated payload under Bun on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
